verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents processing in 150+ currencies and acquiring that lets merchants 'get paid in local currencies, settle funds fast.' For FX transparency, it offers an FX rates API exposing the indicative rates it uses for acquiring. Reconciliation reports include an explicit 'Exchange (FX) rate fee' category and Settlement Breakdown reports. Missing for 10: explicit docs on choosing or converting to the merchant's own settlement currency, published FX markup or pricing (pricing is sales-led), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
